newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar down at 476.75/477.75 dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar down at 476.75/477.75 dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly down at 476.75/477.75 bolivars per dollar on the wrong assumption the Central Bank would intervene, brokers said.

"There was less demand than in recent days, the market was stable until late afternoon when banks went up one bolivar expecting the Central Bank to come in, but it did not," one trader said. "That's basically why the dollar went up."
Most brokers expect the Central Bank to be quite present on Friday to cover demand.
